description: Mexico City - Sample Rooftop Solar Mapping Potential is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy efficiency, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Daron Bedrosyan; Clara Ivanescu; Albertine Potter van Loon (NEO). This dataset contains solar rooftop potential data (installable capacity, estimated electricity generation) for a sample area of interest in Mexico City. The data was gathered by extracting building rooftop footprint polygons from very high resolution stereosatelite imagery. Detailed methodology is available upon specific request. Coverage: Mexico. It has 7 files in Other, SHP, XLS, CSV. The portal files it under Energy efficiency, Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
